scenes.setting: The basement notebook: the Abraham family — Tudor-era titans cursed since ancestor Bethel vanished in the War of the Four Emperors, every Beyonder generation losing control (Mr. Door's full-moon cries?); it yields the Apprentice, Trickmaster and ASTROLOGER formulas before its author's fatal full-moon advancement

Home via East Borough, formulas verified above the fog — then a staged prayer from The World (in a mocked-up 'ordinary room') is beamed to Miss Magician: the Trickmaster formula, hers for Sun-domain purification items
scenes.text_anchor: “Please tell Miss Magician that I've already obtained the Trickmaster potion formula.
